laws.consequence: Conflation treats an in-memory append as durability, defeating `HostInvoked(E) ⇒ DurableIssued(E)` and the WAL gap checks.

laws.consequence: Conflation re-executes an effect that may already have happened — a double-spend/double-write hazard; it is also prohibited outright by R-CLAIM-02.

laws.statement: `SchedulerTrace ≠ EventLog`. The scheduler trace is an INPUT the machine CONSUMES to resolve its nondeterministic choices; the event log is an OUTPUT the machine PRODUCES as it runs.
